title.zh: 卷四十一 本紀第四十一: 順帝四
title.raw: 卷四十一 本紀第四十一: 順帝四 Volume 41 Annals 41: Shundi 4

sentences.zh: 順帝四

translations.literal: Shundi 4
translations.idiomatic: Shundi 4

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙子，中書左丞許有壬辭職。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, on bingzi day, Xu Youren, left vice director of the Secretariat, resigned his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the bingzi day of the first month of spring, Xu Youren, left vice director of the Secretariat, resigned his post.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，中書平章政事納麟辭職。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Nalin, chief minister of the Secretariat, resigned his post.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Nalin, chief minister of the Secretariat, resigned his post.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，沙汰怯薛丹名數。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the registered rolls of the keshik guard corps were purged.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the registered rolls of the keshik guard corps were purged.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，祭社稷。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuxu day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuxu day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太陰犯井宿，填星犯牛宿，熒惑犯羅堰。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion; Saturn transgressed the Ox mansion; Mars transgressed the Luoyan asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion, Saturn transgressed the Ox mansion, and Mars transgressed the Luoyan asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁未，立四川省檢校官。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, inspection commissioners for Sichuan Province were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, inspection commissioners for Sichuan Province were established.

sentences.zh: 遼陽吾者野人叛。

translations.literal: The Wuzhe barbarians of Liaoyang rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuzhe barbarians of Liaoyang rebelled.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太陰犯氐宿。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the moon transgressed the Di mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the moon transgressed the Di mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，汴梁路新鄭、密二縣地震。

translations.literal: That month, Xinzheng and Mi counties of Bianliang Circuit suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xinzheng and Mi counties in Bianliang Circuit were struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 寶慶路饑，判官文殊奴以所受敕牒貸官糧萬石賑之。

translations.literal: Baoqing Circuit suffered famine; the assistant prefect Wenshunu lent ten thousand piculs of official grain, using the patent of commission he had received, to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: Baoqing Circuit was starving. The assistant prefect Wenshunu used the patent of commission he had received to lend ten thousand piculs of official grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 秦州成紀縣，鞏昌府寧遠、伏羌縣山崩，水湧，溺死人無算。

translations.literal: In Chengji County of Qinzhou, and in Ningyuan and Fuqiang counties of Gongchang Prefecture, mountains collapsed and water burst forth, drowning people beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: In Chengji County in Qinzhou, and in Ningyuan and Fuqiang counties in Gongchang Prefecture, mountains collapsed and water surged forth, drowning people beyond count.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，造鹿頂殿。

translations.literal: Third month, on renshen day, the Stag-Peak Hall was constructed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renshen day, the Stag-Peak Hall was constructed.

sentences.zh: 監察御史成遵等言：「可用終場下第舉人充學正、山長，國學生會試不中者，與終場舉人同。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Cheng Zun and others submitted: "Those who complete the final examination session but fail to pass may be appointed as Rectors and Mountain Chiefs. Students of the National University who fail the metropolitan examination should be treated the same as those who complete the final session."
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Cheng Zun and others submitted: "Candidates who complete the final examination session but fail to pass may be appointed as rectors and mountain chiefs. Students of the National University who fail the metropolitan examination should be treated the same as those who complete the final session."

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，詔：「作新風憲。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, an edict stated: "Establish new regulations for the Censorate."
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, an edict stated: "Establish new regulations for the Censorate."

sentences.zh: 在內之官有不法者，監察御史劾之；

translations.literal: Over officials within the capital who act unlawfully, the supervising secretaries shall impeach them;
translations.idiomatic: Officials within the capital who act unlawfully shall be impeached by the supervising secretaries;

sentences.zh: 在外之官有不法者，行臺監察御史劾之。

translations.literal: over officials outside the capital who act unlawfully, the supervising secretaries of the Branch Secretariat shall impeach them.
translations.idiomatic: officials outside the capital who act unlawfully shall be impeached by the supervising secretaries of the branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 歲以八月終出巡，次年四月中還司。

translations.literal: Each year they shall complete their tour of inspection by the end of the eighth month and return to their offices by the middle of the fourth month of the following year."
translations.idiomatic: Each year they shall complete their tour of inspection by the end of the eighth month and return to their offices by the middle of the fourth month of the following year."

sentences.zh: 」壬午，太陰犯氐宿。

translations.literal: On rengwu day, the moon transgressed the Di mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the rengwu day, the moon transgressed the Di mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔修遼、金、宋三史，以中書右丞相脫脫為都總裁官，中書平章政事鐵木兒塔識、中書右丞太平、御史中丞張起巖、翰林學士歐陽玄、侍御史呂思誠、翰林侍講學士揭傒斯為總裁官。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered the compilation of the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song, with Toqto, right chief minister of the Secretariat, as chief compiler; Temür Tash, chief minister of the Secretariat; Taiping, right vice director of the Secretariat; Zhang Qiyan, vice censor-in-chief; Ouyang Xuan, Hanlin Academician; Lü Sicheng, Attending Censor; and Jie Xisi, Hanlin Academician Expositor, as compilers.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict ordered the compilation of the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song. Toqto, right chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed chief compiler; Temür Tash, Taiping, Zhang Qiyan, Ouyang Xuan, Lü Sicheng, and Jie Xisi were appointed compilers.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the first day bingshen of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day bingshen of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On yisi day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是月，兩都桑果葉皆生黃色龍文。

translations.literal: That month, mulberry and fruit leaves in both capitals bore yellow dragon patterns.
translations.idiomatic: That month, mulberry and fruit leaves in both capitals bore yellow dragon patterns.

sentences.zh: 車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月，河決白茅口。

translations.literal: Fifth month, the Yellow River burst through at Baimao Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Yellow River burst through at Baimao Pass.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，命經筵官月進講者三。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renzi day, it was ordered that lecturers of the Classics Colloquium present three lectures per month.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renzi day, it was ordered that lecturers of the Classics Colloquium present three lectures per month.

sentences.zh: 是月，回回剌裏五百餘人渡河寇掠解、吉、隰等州。

translations.literal: That month, more than five hundred Hui Muslims crossed the river and raided Jie, Ji, Xi, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That month, more than five hundred Hui Muslims crossed the river and raided Jie, Ji, Xi, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 中書戶部以國用不足，請撙節浮費。

translations.literal: The Secretariat and Ministry of Revenue, finding state expenditures insufficient, requested reduction of superfluous expenses.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat and Ministry of Revenue, finding state expenditures insufficient, requested a reduction of superfluous expenses.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingmao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingmao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，修大都城。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the walls of Dadu were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the walls of Dadu were repaired.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，立永昌等處宣慰司。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Pacification Commissions for Yongchang and other places were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, pacification commissions for Yongchang and other places were established.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太白犯右執法。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 是月，興國路大旱，河南自四月至是月霖雨不止。

translations.literal: That month, Xingguo Circuit suffered severe drought; south of the Yellow River, from the fourth month until this month, rain fell without cease.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xingguo Circuit suffered severe drought, while south of the Yellow River rain had fallen without cease from the fourth month until this month.

sentences.zh: 戶部復言撙節錢糧。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue again reported on economizing money and grain.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue again reported on economizing money and grain.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午朔，晉寧路臨汾縣獻嘉禾，一莖有八穗者。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the first day jiawu of the month, Jinfen County of Jinning Circuit presented auspicious grain; one stalk bore eight ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the first day jiawu of the month, Jinfen County in Jinning Circuit presented auspicious grain, one stalk bearing eight ears.

sentences.zh: 命朵思麻同知宣慰司事鎖兒哈等討四川上蓬瑣吃賊。

translations.literal: Duosima was ordered to serve as associate commissioner of the Pacification Commission together with Suo'erha and others to campaign against the Shangpeng Suochi bandits in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Duosima was ordered to serve as associate commissioner of the pacification commission together with Suo'erha and others to campaign against the Shangpeng Suochi bandits in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 山東有賊焚掠兗州。

translations.literal: In Shandong, bandits burned and plundered Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Shandong, bandits burned and plundered Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，湖廣行省平章政事鞏卜班擒道州、賀州徭賊首唐大二、蔣仁五至京，誅之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiazi day, Gongbuban, chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, captured the Yao bandit chieftains Tang Da'er and Jiang Renwu of Daozhou and Hezhou and sent them to the capital; they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiazi day, Gongbuban, chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, captured the Yao bandit chieftains Tang Da'er and Jiang Renwu of Daozhou and Hezhou and sent them to the capital, where they were executed.

sentences.zh: 其黨蔣丙，自號順天王，攻破連、桂二州。

translations.literal: Their follower Jiang Bing styled himself King Shuntian and overran Lian and Gui prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Their follower Jiang Bing styled himself King Shuntian and overran Lian and Gui prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲申，修理太廟，遣官告祭，奉遷神主於後殿。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the Imperial Ancestral Temple was repaired; officials were sent to announce the sacrifice and escort the spirit tablets to the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the Imperial Ancestral Temple was repaired. Officials were sent to announce the sacrifice and escort the spirit tablets to the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，增立巡防捕盜所於永昌。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yiwei day, patrol posts for catching bandits were additionally established in Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yiwei day, additional patrol posts for catching bandits were established in Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，告祭太廟，奉安神主。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, sacrifice was announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the spirit tablets were enshrined.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, sacrifice was announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the spirit tablets were enshrined.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，帝將祀南郊，告祭太廟。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, as the Emperor was about to sacrifice at the Southern Altar, he announced sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, as the emperor was about to sacrifice at the Southern Altar, he announced sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 至寧宗室，問曰：「朕，寧宗兄也，當拜否？

translations.literal: Before the spirit tablet of Emperor Ningzong, he asked: "I am the elder brother of Ningzong—should I bow?"
translations.idiomatic: Before the spirit tablet of Emperor Ningzong, he asked: "I am Ningzong's elder brother—should I bow?"

sentences.zh: 」太常博士劉聞對曰：「寧宗雖弟，其為帝時，陛下為之臣。

translations.literal: Liu Wen, Academic Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, replied: "Although Ningzong was your younger brother, when he was emperor you were his subject.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wen, academic director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, replied: "Although Ningzong was your younger brother, when he was emperor you were his subject.

sentences.zh: 春秋時，魯閔公弟也，僖公兄也，閔公先為君，宗廟之祭，未聞僖公不拜。

translations.literal: In the Spring and Autumn period, Duke Min of Lu was the younger brother and Duke Xi the elder; yet when Min first became ruler, it is not recorded that Xi did not bow at the ancestral sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the Spring and Autumn period, Duke Min of Lu was the younger brother and Duke Xi the elder, yet when Min first became ruler it is not recorded that Xi did not bow at the ancestral sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 陛下當拜。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should bow."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should bow."

sentences.zh: 」帝乃拜。

translations.literal: The Emperor then bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then bowed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，月食。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, there was a lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, there was a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己酉，帝親祀上帝於南郊，以太祖配。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the Emperor in person sacrificed to the Supreme Deity at the Southern Altar, with Taizu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the emperor in person sacrificed to the Supreme Deity at the Southern Altar, with Taizu as associate.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命僉樞密院事韓元善為中書參知政事，中書參議買木丁同知宣徽院事。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Han Yuanshan, Concurrent Commissioner of the Privy Council, was appointed Vice Grand Councillor of the Secretariat; Maiding, Secretariat Consultant, was appointed Associate Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Han Yuanshan, concurrent commissioner of the Privy Council, was appointed vice grand councillor of the Secretariat; Maiding, secretariat consultant, was appointed associate commissioner of the Court of Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 己未，以郊祀禮成，詔大赦天下，文官普減一資，武官升散官一等，蠲民間田租五分，賜高年帛。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, because the suburban sacrifice was completed, an edict proclaimed general amnesty throughout the empire; civil officials were generally reduced one rank in seniority, military officers promoted one grade in honorary rank, five-tenths of the year's field tax was remitted, and cloth was bestowed on the aged.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, because the suburban sacrifice was completed, an edict proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the empire. Civil officials were generally reduced one rank in seniority, military officers were promoted one grade in honorary rank, five-tenths of the year's field tax was remitted, and cloth was bestowed on the aged.

sentences.zh: 以湖廣行省平章政事鞏卜班為宣徽院使，行樞密院知院剌剌為翰林學士承旨。

translations.literal: Gongbuban was made Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Treasury; Lala, Administrator of the Branch Privy Council, was made Chief Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Gongbuban was made commissioner of the Court of Imperial Treasury, and Lala, administrator of the branch Privy Council, was made chief Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，詔寫金字《藏經》。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingshen day, an edict ordered transcription of the 《Buddhist Canon》 in gold characters.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingshen day, an edict ordered transcription of the 《Buddhist Canon》 in gold characters.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以別兒怯不花為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Bierqiebuhua was appointed left chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Bierqiebuhua was appointed left chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，膠州及屬邑高密地震。

translations.literal: That month, in Jiaozhou and its subordinate Gaomi county there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jiaozhou and its subordinate Gaomi county were struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 河南等處民饑，賑糶麥十萬石。

translations.literal: The people of Henan and other regions suffered famine; one hundred thousand piculs of wheat were distributed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Henan and other regions were starving. One hundred thousand piculs of wheat were distributed for relief.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔立常平倉，罷民間食鹽。

translations.literal: That year, an edict ordered establishment of Ever-Normal Granaries and abolition of private salt sales.
translations.idiomatic: That year, an edict ordered the establishment of Ever-Normal Granaries and the abolition of private salt sales.

sentences.zh: 征遺逸脫因、伯顏、張瑾、杜本，本辭不至。

translations.literal: Recluses Tuoyin, Bayan, Zhang Jin, and Du Ben were summoned; Ben declined and did not come.
translations.idiomatic: The recluses Tuoyin, Bayan, Zhang Jin, and Du Ben were summoned. Du Ben declined and did not come.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the xinwei day of the first month of spring, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔：「定守令黜陟之法，六事備者升一等，四事備者減一資，三事備者平遷，六事俱不備者降一等。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, an edict stated: "Establish regulations for the promotion and demotion of prefects and magistrates. Those who fulfill all six criteria shall be promoted one grade; those who fulfill four shall be reduced one rank in seniority; those who fulfill three shall be transferred without change; those who fulfill none of the six shall be demoted one grade."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, an edict stated: "Establish regulations for the promotion and demotion of prefects and magistrates. Those who fulfill all six criteria shall be promoted one grade; those who fulfill four shall be reduced one rank in seniority; those who fulfill three shall be transferred without change; those who fulfill none of the six shall be demoted one grade."

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，河決曹州，雇夫萬五千八百修築之。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the Yellow River burst its banks at Caozhou; fifteen thousand eight hundred laborers were hired to repair the dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the Yellow River burst its banks at Caozhou. Fifteen thousand eight hundred laborers were hired to repair the dikes.

sentences.zh: 是月，河又決汴梁。

translations.literal: That month, the river again burst its banks at Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the river again burst its banks at Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，祭社稷。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuxu day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuxu day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，四川行省立惠民藥局。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Public Welfare Pharmacies were established in the Sichuan branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, public welfare pharmacies were established in the Sichuan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，中書右丞太平升平章政事。

translations.literal: That month, Taiping, right vice director of the Secretariat, was promoted to chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Taiping, right vice director of the Secretariat, was promoted to chief minister.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛酉朔，永平、澧州等路饑，賑之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on the first day xinyou of the month, Yongping, Lizhou, and other circuits suffered famine; relief was provided.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the first day xinyou of the month, Yongping, Lizhou, and other circuits were starving and were given relief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，月食。

translations.literal: On yihai day, there was a lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, there was a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，復立武功縣。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingyou day, Wugong County was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingyou day, Wugong County was re-established.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，特授八禿麻朵兒只征東行省左丞相，嗣高麗國王。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Batma Dorji was specially appointed left chief minister of the Eastern Campaign Branch Secretariat and succeeded to the kingship of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Batma Dorji was specially appointed left chief minister of the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat and succeeded to the kingship of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以河南行省平章政事納麟為中書平章政事，集賢大學士姚庸為中書左丞。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Nalin, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat; Yao Yong, Grand Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, was appointed left vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Nalin, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat, and Yao Yong, grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, was appointed left vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，復立廣樣局。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dinghai day, the Broad Pattern Bureau was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dinghai day, the Broad Pattern Bureau was re-established.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，右丞相脫脫辭職，不許；

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yiwei day, Toqto, right chief minister, resigned his post; the request was not granted;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yiwei day, Toqto, right chief minister, resigned his post. The request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，許之，以阿魯圖為中書右丞相。

translations.literal: on jiachen day, it was granted; Arutu was appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, it was granted, and Arutu was appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，封脫脫為鄭王，食邑安豐，賜金印及海青、文豹等物，俱辭不受。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Toqto was enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng with Anfeng as his fief; a gold seal and gifts including sea eagles and patterned leopards were bestowed, all of which he declined.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Toqto was enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng with Anfeng as his fief. A gold seal and gifts including sea eagles and patterned leopards were bestowed, but he declined them all.

sentences.zh: 是月，大霖雨，黃河溢，平地水二丈，決白茅堤、金堤，曹、濮、濟、兗皆被災。

translations.literal: That month, heavy rains fell; the Yellow River overflowed, and water on level ground reached two zhang; the Baimao and Jin dikes burst, and Cao, Pu, Ji, and Yan were all stricken by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month, torrential rains fell. The Yellow River overflowed until water on level ground reached two zhang. The Baimao and Jin dikes burst, and Cao, Pu, Ji, and Yan were all stricken by disaster.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，鞏昌隴西縣饑，每戶貸常平倉粟三斗，俟年豐還官。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuchen day, Longxi County of Gongchang suffered famine; each household was lent three dou of grain from the Ever-Normal Granary to be repaid to the government when the year was abundant.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wuchen day, Longxi County in Gongchang was starving. Each household was lent three dou of grain from the Ever-Normal Granary to be repaid when the harvest was abundant.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賜脫脫松江田，為立松江等處稻田提領所。

translations.literal: On jisi day, fields in Songjiang were granted to Toqto, and a Paddy Fields Supervisory Office for Songjiang and other places was established for him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, fields in Songjiang were granted to Toqto, and a paddy fields supervisory office for Songjiang and other places was established for him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子朔，溫州颶風大作，海水溢，地震。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the first day wuzi of the month, a great hurricane struck Wenzhou; seawater overflowed, and there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day wuzi of the month, a great hurricane struck Wenzhou. Seawater overflowed, and there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 益都瀕海鹽徒郭火你赤作亂。

translations.literal: Guo Huonichi, a coastal salt laborer of Yidu, rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Huonichi, a coastal salt laborer in Yidu, rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 己丑，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jichou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是月，灤河水溢。

translations.literal: That month, the Luan River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Luan River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，祭社稷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wuwu day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuwu day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，山東霖雨，民饑相食，賑之。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, in Shandong prolonged rain fell; the people, starving, ate one another; relief was provided.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, prolonged rain fell in Shandong. The starving people resorted to cannibalism, and relief was provided.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜脫脫金十錠、銀五十錠、鈔萬錠、幣帛二百匹，辭不受。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Toqto was granted ten ingots of gold, fifty ingots of silver, ten thousand ingots of paper money, and two hundred bolts of silk; he declined them.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Toqto was granted ten ingots of gold, fifty ingots of silver, ten thousand ingots of paper money, and two hundred bolts of silk, but he declined them.

sentences.zh: 是月，陜西行省立惠民藥局。

translations.literal: That month, Public Welfare Pharmacies were established in the Shaanxi branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: That month, public welfare pharmacies were established in the Shaanxi branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 莒州蒙陰縣地震。

translations.literal: Mengyin County of Juzhou suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Mengyin County in Juzhou was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 郭火你赤上太行，由陵川入壺關，至廣平，殺兵馬指揮，復還益都。

translations.literal: Guo Huonichi ascended the Taihang range, entered Huguan by way of Lingchuan, reached Guangping, killed the cavalry commander, and then returned to Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Huonichi ascended the Taihang range, entered Huguan by way of Lingchuan, reached Guangping, killed the cavalry commander, and then returned to Yidu.

sentences.zh: 車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on the first day dinghai of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the first day dinghai of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命太平提調都水監。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Taiping was ordered to supervise the Directorate of Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Taiping was ordered to supervise the Directorate of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以南臺治書侍御史秦從德為江浙行省參知政事，提調海運。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Qin Congde, Attending Secretary of the Southern Branch Censorate, was appointed Vice Grand Councillor of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat and ordered to supervise sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Qin Congde, attending secretary of the southern branch censorate, was appointed vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat and ordered to supervise sea transport.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命御史大夫也先帖木兒、平章政事鐵木兒塔識知經筵事，右丞達識帖睦邇提調宣文閣、知經筵事。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Censor-in-Chief Yesun Temur and Chief Minister Temür Tash were ordered to direct the Classics Colloquium; Vice Director Dash Temur was ordered to supervise the Hall of Promoting Culture and direct the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Censor-in-Chief Yesun Temur and Chief Minister Temür Tash were ordered to direct the Classics Colloquium, and Vice Director Dash Temur was ordered to supervise the Hall of Promoting Culture and direct the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，議修黃河、淮河堤堰。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yiyou day, repair of the Yellow River and Huai River dikes was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yiyou day, repair of the Yellow River and Huai River dikes was discussed.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥朔，以各郡縣民饑，不許抑配食鹽。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on the first day dinghai of the month, because the people of the various prefectures and counties were starving, compulsory allocation of salt was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the first day dinghai of the month, because the people of the various prefectures and counties were starving, compulsory allocation of salt was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 復令民入粟補官，以備賑濟。

translations.literal: The people were again ordered to submit grain for purchase of office, to provide for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The people were again ordered to submit grain in exchange for office, to provide funds for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禁內外官民宴會不得用珠花。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, officials and commoners inside and outside the capital were forbidden to use pearl ornamentation at banquets.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, officials and commoners inside and outside the capital were forbidden to use pearl ornamentation at banquets.

sentences.zh: 己亥，保定路饑，以鈔八萬錠、糧萬石賑之。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Baoding Circuit suffered famine; eighty thousand ingots of paper money and ten thousand piculs of grain were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Baoding Circuit was starving. Eighty thousand ingots of paper money and ten thousand piculs of grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，河南民饑，禁酒。

translations.literal: On wushen day, the people of Henan suffered famine; wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, the people of Henan were starving, and wine was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，四川廉訪司建言：「廣元等五路，廣安等三府，永寧等兩宣撫司，請依內郡設置推官一員。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiwei day, the surveillance commission of Sichuan submitted: "In the five circuits of Guangyuan and elsewhere, the three prefectures of Guang'an and elsewhere, and the two pacification commissions of Yongning and elsewhere, we request that one investigating official be established in each, as in the inner circuits."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiwei day, the surveillance commission of Sichuan submitted: "In the five circuits of Guangyuan and elsewhere, the three prefectures of Guang'an and elsewhere, and the two pacification commissions of Yongning and elsewhere, we request that one investigating official be established in each, as in the inner circuits."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太陰犯外屏。

translations.literal: On renxu day, the moon transgressed the Outer Screen.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the moon transgressed the Outer Screen.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，漢陽地震。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Hanyang suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Hanyang was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，徭賊寇靖州。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Yao bandits raided Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Yao bandits raided Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，東平地震。

translations.literal: That month, Dongping suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dongping was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 禁淫祠。

translations.literal: Immoral shrines were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Immoral shrines were prohibited.

sentences.zh: 賑東昌、濟南、般陽、慶元、撫州饑民。

translations.literal: The starving people of Dongchang, Jinan, Panyang, Qingyuan, and Fuzhou were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: The starving people of Dongchang, Jinan, Panyang, Qingyuan, and Fuzhou were given relief.

sentences.zh: 是歲，徭賊寇潯州，同知府事保童率民兵擊走之。

translations.literal: That year, Yao bandits raided Xunzhou; Baotong, associate prefect, led militia and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Yao bandits raided Xunzhou. Baotong, associate prefect, led militia and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, on xinmao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the xinmao day of the first month of spring, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是月，薊州地震。

translations.literal: That month, Jizhou suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jizhou was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，祭社稷。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuwu day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuwu day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，帝親試進士七十有八人，賜普顏不花、張士堅進士及第，其餘賜出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinmao day, the Emperor personally examined seventy-eight jinshi candidates; Pu'erbughua and Zhang Shijian were granted jinshi with honors; the rest received office by rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinmao day, the emperor personally examined seventy-eight jinshi candidates. Pu'erbughua and Zhang Shijian were granted jinshi with honors, and the rest received office by rank.

sentences.zh: 是月，以陳思謙參議中書省事。

translations.literal: That month, Chen Siqian was appointed to participate in Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Chen Siqian was appointed to participate in secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 先是，思謙建言：「所在盜起，蓋由歲饑民貧，宜大發倉廩賑之，以收人心，仍分布重兵鎮撫中夏。

translations.literal: Previously, Siqian had submitted: "Bandits rise everywhere because the year is lean and the people poor; grain from the storehouses should be liberally issued for relief to win hearts, and heavy troops should be deployed to pacify central China."
translations.idiomatic: Previously, Siqian had submitted: "Bandits are rising everywhere because famine has left the people poor. Grain from the storehouses should be liberally issued for relief to win hearts, and heavy troops should be deployed to pacify central China."

sentences.zh: 」不聽。

translations.literal: The proposal was not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 大都、永平、鞏昌、興國、安陸等處並桃溫萬戶府各翼人民饑，賑之。

translations.literal: Dadu, Yongping, Gongchang, Xingguo, Anlu, and other places, and the people of the various wings of the Taowen Ten Thousand-Households Office, all suffered famine; relief was provided.
translations.idiomatic: Dadu, Yongping, Gongchang, Xingguo, Anlu, and other places, and the people of the various wings of the Taowen Ten Thousand-Households Office, were all starving and were given relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，大都流民，官給路糧，遣其還鄉。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingmao day, for wandering refugees in Dadu, travel grain was provided by the government and they were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingmao day, for wandering refugees in Dadu, travel grain was provided by the government and they were sent home.

sentences.zh: 是月，汴梁、濟南、邠州、瑞州等處民饑，賑之。

translations.literal: That month, the people of Bianliang, Jinan, Binzhou, Ruizhou, and other places suffered famine; relief was provided.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the people of Bianliang, Jinan, Binzhou, Ruizhou, and other places were starving and were given relief.

sentences.zh: 募富戶出米五十石以上者，旌以義士之號。

translations.literal: The wealthy were recruited to donate fifty piculs of grain or more; they were honored with the title Righteous Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: The wealthy were recruited to donate fifty piculs of grain or more and were honored with the title Righteous Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，詔以軍士所掠雲南子女一千一百人放還鄉里，仍給其行糧，不願歸者聽。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jichou day, an edict ordered that one thousand one hundred men and women seized in Yunnan by soldiers be released to return to their home districts; travel grain was still provided, and those unwilling to return were permitted to stay.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jichou day, an edict ordered that one thousand one hundred men and women seized in Yunnan by soldiers be released to return home. Travel grain was still provided, and those unwilling to return were permitted to stay.

sentences.zh: 丁未，河間轉運司竈戶被水災，詔權免余鹽二萬引，候年豐補還官。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the salt wells of the Hejian Transport Office suffered flood damage; an edict temporarily exempted twenty thousand surplus salt certificates, to be repaid to the government when the year was abundant.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the salt wells of the Hejian transport office suffered flood damage. An edict temporarily exempted twenty thousand surplus salt certificates, to be repaid when the harvest was abundant.

sentences.zh: 六月，廬州張順興出米五百餘石賑饑，旌其門。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Zhang Shunxing of Luzhou donated more than five hundred piculs of grain for famine relief; his gate was honored.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Zhang Shunxing of Luzhou donated more than five hundred piculs of grain for famine relief, and his gate was honored.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，河決濟陰。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dinghai day, the Yellow River burst its banks at Jiyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dinghai day, the Yellow River burst its banks at Jiyin.

sentences.zh: 己丑，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jichou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命也先帖木兒、鐵木兒塔識並為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Yesun Temur and Temür Tash were both appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Yesun Temur and Temür Tash were both appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 詔作新風紀。

translations.literal: An edict ordered establishment of new regulations on conduct.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the establishment of new regulations on conduct.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，祭社稷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wuwu day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuwu day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on the first day xinsi of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the first day xinsi of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，開酒禁。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the prohibition on wine was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the prohibition on wine was lifted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以中書右丞達識帖睦邇為翰林學士承旨，中書參知政事搠思監為右丞，資政院使朵兒直班為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Dash Temur, right vice director of the Secretariat, was appointed chief Hanlin academician; Suosijian, vice grand councillor of the Secretariat, was appointed right vice director; Dorjiban, Commissioner of the Bureau of Excellent Governance, was appointed vice grand councillor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Dash Temur, right vice director of the Secretariat, was appointed chief Hanlin academician; Suosijian, vice grand councillor of the Secretariat, was appointed right vice director; and Dorjiban, commissioner of the Bureau of Excellent Governance, was appointed vice grand councillor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，革罷奧魯。

translations.literal: That month, the aoru offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the aoru offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子，以中書平章政事太平為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renzi day, Taiping, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renzi day, Taiping, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On yimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命奉使宣撫巡行天下，詔曰：

translations.literal: On xinyou day, commissioners were ordered to tour the realm as pacification envoys. The edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, commissioners were ordered to tour the realm as pacification envoys. The edict stated:

sentences.zh: 朕自踐祚以來，至今十有餘年，托身億兆之上，端居九重之中，耳目所及，豈能周知？

translations.literal: "Since I ascended the throne, more than ten years have passed. Resting above the hundred million, dwelling at ease within the ninefold palace, what my eyes and ears reach—how could I know it all?"
translations.idiomatic: "Since I ascended the throne, more than ten years have passed. Resting above the hundred million, dwelling at ease within the ninefold palace, what my eyes and ears reach—how could I know it all?"

sentences.zh: 故雖夙夜憂勤，覬安黎庶，而和氣未臻，災眚時作，聲教未洽，風俗未淳，吏弊未祛，民瘼滋甚。

translations.literal: "Therefore, though I toil in concern from dawn to dusk, hoping to settle the common people, harmonious qi has not yet arrived, disasters and portents arise in season, sound instruction has not yet spread, customs are not yet pure, official abuses are not yet removed, and the people's afflictions grow ever worse."
translations.idiomatic: "Therefore, though I toil in concern from dawn to dusk, hoping to settle the common people, harmonious qi has not yet arrived, disasters and portents arise in season, sound instruction has not yet spread, customs are not yet pure, official abuses are not yet removed, and the people's afflictions grow ever worse."

sentences.zh: 豈承宣之寄，糾劾之司，奉行有所未至歟？

translations.literal: "Is it perhaps that those entrusted with proclaiming my will and the offices charged with impeachment have not fully carried out their duties?"
translations.idiomatic: "Is it perhaps that those entrusted with proclaiming my will and the offices charged with impeachment have not fully carried out their duties?"

sentences.zh: 若稽先朝成憲，遣官分道奉使宣撫，布朕德意，詢民疾苦，疏滌冤滯，蠲除煩苛。

translations.literal: "Following the established statutes of former reigns, officials shall be sent on separate routes as pacification envoys to spread my virtuous intent, inquire into the people's hardships, clear away accumulated wrongs, and remit oppressive exactions."
translations.idiomatic: "Following the established statutes of former reigns, officials shall be sent on separate routes as pacification envoys to spread my virtuous intent, inquire into the people's hardships, clear away accumulated wrongs, and remit oppressive exactions."

sentences.zh: 體察官吏賢否，明加黜陟，有罪者，四品以上停職申請，五品以下就便處決。

translations.literal: "They shall investigate whether officials are worthy or not and clearly promote or demote them. For the guilty, those of the fourth rank and above shall be suspended from office pending application; those of the fifth rank and below shall be dealt with on the spot."
translations.idiomatic: "They shall investigate whether officials are worthy or not and clearly promote or demote them. For the guilty, those of the fourth rank and above shall be suspended from office pending application; those of the fifth rank and below shall be dealt with on the spot."

sentences.zh: 民間一切興利除害之事，悉聽舉行。

translations.literal: "All matters throughout the realm that benefit the people or remove harm shall be permitted to be undertaken."
translations.idiomatic: "All matters throughout the realm that benefit the people or remove harm shall be permitted to be undertaken."

sentences.zh: 命江西行省左丞忽都不丁、吏部尚書何執禮巡兩浙江東道，前雲南行省右丞散散、將作院使王士弘巡江西福建道，大都路達魯花赤拔實、江浙行省參知政事秦從德巡江南湖廣道，吏部尚書定僧、宣政僉院魏景道巡河南江北道，資政院使蠻子、兵部尚書李獻巡燕南山東道，兵部尚書不花、樞密院判官靳義巡河東陜西道，宣政院同知伯家奴、宣徽僉院王也速叠兒巡山北遼東道，荊湖北道宣慰使阿乞剌、兩淮運使杜德遠巡雲南省，上都留守阿牙赤、陜西行省左丞王紳巡甘肅永昌道，大都留守答爾麻失裏、河南行省參知政事王守誠巡四川省，前西臺中丞定定、集賢侍講學士蘇天爵巡京畿道，平江路達魯花赤左答納失裏、都水監賈惟貞巡海北海南廣東道。

translations.literal: Orders were issued: Hu Dubai, left vice director of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, and He Zhili, Minister of Personnel, to tour the two Zhejiangs and Jiangdong Circuit; Sansan, former right vice director of the Yunnan branch secretariat, and Wang Shihong, Commissioner of the Directorate of Construction, to tour Jiangxi and Fujian Circuit; Bashi, darughachi of Dadu, and Qin Congde, vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, to tour Jiangnan and Huguang Circuit; Dingseng, Minister of Personnel, and Wei Jingdao, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, to tour Henan and Jiangbei Circuit; Manzi, Commissioner of the Bureau of Excellent Governance, and Li Xian, Minister of War, to tour Yanshan and Shandong Circuit; Buhua, Minister of War, and Jin Yi, judge of the Privy Council, to tour Hedong and Shaanxi Circuit; Berkanu, Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, and Wang Yisudier, Vice Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Treasury, to tour Shanbei and Liaodong Circuit; Aqili, Pacification Commissioner of Jinghu North Circuit, and Du Deyuan, Transport Commissioner of the Two Huai, to tour Yunnan Province; Ayachi, Commander of the Upper Capital Garrison, and Wang Shen, left vice director of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, to tour Gansu and Yongchang Circuit; Darmashili, Commander of the Dadu Garrison, and Wang Shoucheng, vice grand councillor of the Henan branch secretariat, to tour Sichuan Province; Dingding, former vice censor-in-chief of the Western Branch, and Su Tianjue, Hanlin Attending Academician, to tour the Capital Circuit; Zuodanashili, darughachi of Pingjiang, and Jia Weizhen, Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways, to tour Haibei, Hainan, and Guangdong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Orders were issued: Hu Dubai, left vice director of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, and He Zhili, minister of personnel, to tour the two Zhejiangs and Jiangdong circuit; Sansan, former right vice director of the Yunnan branch secretariat, and Wang Shihong, commissioner of the directorate of construction, to tour Jiangxi and Fujian circuit; Bashi, darughachi of Dadu, and Qin Congde, vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, to tour Jiangnan and Huguang circuit; Dingseng, minister of personnel, and Wei Jingdao, vice commissioner of the bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan affairs, to tour Henan and Jiangbei circuit; Manzi, commissioner of the bureau of excellent governance, and Li Xian, minister of war, to tour Yanshan and Shandong circuit; Buhua, minister of war, and Jin Yi, judge of the privy council, to tour Hedong and Shaanxi circuit; Berkanu, associate commissioner of the bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan affairs, and Wang Yisudier, vice commissioner of the court of imperial treasury, to tour Shanbei and Liaodong circuit; Aqili, pacification commissioner of Jinghu North circuit, and Du Deyuan, transport commissioner of the two Huai, to tour Yunnan province; Ayachi, commander of the upper capital garrison, and Wang Shen, left vice director of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, to tour Gansu and Yongchang circuit; Darmashili, commander of the Dadu garrison, and Wang Shoucheng, vice grand councillor of the Henan branch secretariat, to tour Sichuan province; Dingding, former vice censor-in-chief of the western branch, and Su Tianjue, Hanlin attending academician, to tour the capital circuit; Zuodanashili, darughachi of Pingjiang, and Jia Weizhen, commissioner of the directorate of waterways, to tour Haibei, Hainan, and Guangdong circuit.

sentences.zh: 黃河泛溢。

translations.literal: The Yellow River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遼、金、宋三史成，右丞相阿魯圖進之，帝曰：「史既成書，前人善者，朕當取以為法，惡者取以為戒，然豈止激勸為君者，為臣者亦當知之。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song were completed. Arutu, right chief minister, presented them. The Emperor said: "Now that the histories are completed, where the men of old did well, I shall take them as models; where they did ill, I shall take them as warnings. Yet this is not only to encourage rulers—ministers too should know them."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song were completed. Arutu, right chief minister, presented them. The emperor said: "Now that the histories are completed, where the men of old did well, I shall take them as models; where they did ill, I shall take them as warnings. Yet this is not only to encourage rulers—ministers too should know them."

sentences.zh: 卿等其體朕心，以前代善惡為勉。

translations.literal: "You ministers should take my heart as your own and take the good and ill of former ages as your admonition."
translations.idiomatic: "You ministers should take my heart as your own and take the good and ill of former ages as your admonition."

sentences.zh: 」己卯，監察御史不答失裏請罷造作不急之務。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Supervising Secretary Budaqili requested that non-urgent construction projects be halted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, supervising secretary Budaqili requested that non-urgent construction projects be halted.

sentences.zh: 是月，以呂思誠為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: That month, Lü Sicheng was appointed vice grand councillor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Lü Sicheng was appointed vice grand councillor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，《至正條格》成。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day, the 《Zhengzheng Statutes》 were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiawu day, the 《Zhengzheng Statutes》 were completed.

sentences.zh: 奉元路陳望叔偽稱燕帖古思太子，伏誅。

translations.literal: Chen Wangshu of Fengyuan Circuit falsely claimed to be Prince Yantughus and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Wangshu of Fengyuan Circuit falsely claimed to be Prince Yantughus and was executed.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，詔定薦舉守令法。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingsi day, an edict established regulations for recommending prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingsi day, an edict established regulations for recommending prefects and magistrates.

sentences.zh: 是歲，宣徽院使篤憐鐵穆邇知樞密院事，馮思溫為御史中丞。

translations.literal: That year, Dolintemur, Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Treasury, was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Feng Siwen was made vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Dolintemur, commissioner of the Court of Imperial Treasury, was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Feng Siwen was made vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 六年春二月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, second month, on the first day gengxu of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the first day gengxu of the second month of spring, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛未，興國雨雹，大者如馬首。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, hail fell in Xingguo; the largest stones were the size of a horse's head.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, hail fell in Xingguo; the largest stones were the size of a horse's head.

sentences.zh: 是月，山東地震，七日乃止。

translations.literal: That month, Shandong suffered an earthquake that continued for seven days before ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shandong was struck by an earthquake that continued for seven days before ceasing.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，盜扼李開務之閘河，劫商旅船。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinwei day, bandits seized control of the sluice canal at Likaiwu and plundered merchant and traveler boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinwei day, bandits seized control of the sluice canal at Likaiwu and plundered merchant and traveler boats.

sentences.zh: 兩淮運使宋文瓚言：「世皇開會通河千有餘里，歲運米至京者五百萬石。

translations.literal: Song Wenchan, Transport Commissioner of the Two Huai, submitted: "The Shizu Emperor opened the Huitong Canal for more than a thousand li; each year five million piculs of grain were transported to the capital."
translations.idiomatic: Song Wenchan, transport commissioner of the two Huai, submitted: "The Shizu emperor opened the Huitong Canal for more than a thousand li; each year five million piculs of grain were transported to the capital."

sentences.zh: 今騎賊不過四十人，劫船三百艘而莫能捕，恐運道阻塞，乞選能臣率壯勇千騎捕之。

translations.literal: "Now mounted bandits number no more than forty, yet they have plundered three hundred boats without being captured. I fear the transport route will be blocked and beg that a capable minister be chosen to lead a thousand brave horsemen to capture them."
translations.idiomatic: "Now mounted bandits number no more than forty, yet they have plundered three hundred boats without being captured. I fear the transport route will be blocked and beg that a capable minister be chosen to lead a thousand brave horsemen to capture them."

sentences.zh: 」不聽。

translations.literal: The request was not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，京畿盜起，范陽縣請增設縣尉及巡警兵，從之。

translations.literal: On wushen day, bandits rose in the capital region; Fanyang County requested additional county captains and patrol troops; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, bandits rose in the capital region. Fanyang County requested additional county captains and patrol troops, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 山東盜起，詔中書參知政事鎖南班至東平鎮遏。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Shandong; an edict ordered Suonanban, vice grand councillor of the Secretariat, to go to Dongping to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Shandong. An edict ordered Suonanban, vice grand councillor of the Secretariat, to go to Dongping to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 八番龍宜來進馬。

translations.literal: Longyi of the Eight Circuits came to present horses.
translations.idiomatic: Longyi of the Eight Circuits came to present horses.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，遼陽為捕海東青煩擾，吾者野人及水達達皆叛。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renzi day, because the pursuit of eastern sea hawks in Liaoyang caused great harassment, the Wuzhe barbarians and the Shuidada all rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renzi day, because the pursuit of eastern sea hawks in Liaoyang caused great harassment, the Wuzhe barbarians and the Shuidada all rebelled.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以長吉為皇太子宮傅官。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Changji was appointed tutor to the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Changji was appointed tutor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 頒《至正條格》於天下。

translations.literal: The 《Zhengzheng Statutes》 were promulgated throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Zhengzheng Statutes》 were promulgated throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以中書參知政事呂思誠為左丞。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Lü Sicheng, vice grand councillor of the Secretariat, was appointed left vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Lü Sicheng, vice grand councillor of the Secretariat, was appointed left vice director.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On yimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 發米二十萬石賑糶貧民。

translations.literal: Two hundred thousand piculs of grain were issued to sell at relief prices to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred thousand piculs of grain were issued to sell at relief prices to the poor.

sentences.zh: 萬戶買住等討吾者野人遇害，詔恤其家。

translations.literal: Maizhu and others of the Ten Thousand-Households Office, campaigning against the Wuzhe barbarians, were killed; an edict ordered relief for their families.
translations.idiomatic: Maizhu and others of the Ten Thousand-Households Office, campaigning against the Wuzhe barbarians, were killed. An edict ordered relief for their families.

sentences.zh: 以中書左丞呂思誠知經筵事。

translations.literal: Lü Sicheng, left vice director of the Secretariat, was ordered to direct the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Sicheng, left vice director of the Secretariat, was ordered to direct the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 命左右二司、六部吏屬於午後講習經史。

translations.literal: It was ordered that clerks of the Left and Right Offices and the Six Ministries study the classics and histories in the afternoon.
translations.idiomatic: It was ordered that clerks of the left and right offices and the six ministries study the classics and histories in the afternoon.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，陜西饑，禁酒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renwu day, Shaanxi suffered famine; wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renwu day, Shaanxi was starving, and wine was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 象州盜起。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 江西田賦提舉司擾民，罷之。

translations.literal: The Jiangxi Field-Tax Supervisory Office harassed the people; it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangxi field-tax supervisory office harassed the people and was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，盜竊太廟神主。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, bandits stole the spirit tablets of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, bandits stole the spirit tablets of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 遣火兒忽答討吾者野人。

translations.literal: Huorhuqa was sent to campaign against the Wuzhe barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Huorhuqa was sent to campaign against the Wuzhe barbarians.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以黃河決，立河南山東都水監。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, because the Yellow River had burst its banks, the Henan-Shandong Directorate of Waterways was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, because the Yellow River had burst its banks, the Henan-Shandong directorate of waterways was established.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，汀州連城縣民羅天麟、陳積萬叛，陷長汀縣，福建元帥府經歷真寶、萬戶廉和尚等討之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiyou day, Luo Tianlin and Chen Jiwang of Liancheng County in Tingzhou rebelled and captured Changting County; Zhenbao, administrator of the Fujian Marshal's Office, and Lianheshang of the Ten Thousand-Households Office, among others, campaigned against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiyou day, Luo Tianlin and Chen Jiwang of Liancheng County in Tingzhou rebelled and captured Changting County. Zhenbao, administrator of the Fujian marshal's office, and Lianheshang of the Ten Thousand-Households Office, among others, campaigned against them.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔以雲南賊死可伐盜據一方，侵奪路甸，命亦禿渾為雲南行省平章政事討之。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, an edict stated that the Yunnan bandit Sikewa had seized a region by force and encroached upon the route districts; Yitughun was appointed chief minister of the Yunnan branch secretariat to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, an edict stated that the Yunnan bandit Sikewa had seized a region by force and encroached upon the route districts. Yitughun was appointed chief minister of the Yunnan branch secretariat to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以遼陽吾者野人等未靖，命太保伯撒裏為遼陽行省左丞相鎮之。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, because the Wuzhe barbarians of Liaoyang and others were not yet pacified, Grand Guardian Barsari was appointed left chief minister of the Liaoyang branch secretariat to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, because the Wuzhe barbarians of Liaoyang and others were not yet pacified, Grand Guardian Barsari was appointed left chief minister of the Liaoyang branch secretariat to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，降詔招諭死可伐。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, an edict was issued to summon and persuade Sikewa.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, an edict was issued to summon and persuade Sikewa.

sentences.zh: 散毛洞蠻覃全在叛，招降之，以為散毛誓厓等處軍民宣撫使，置官屬，給宣敕、虎符，設立驛鋪。

translations.literal: Tan Quanzai of the Sanmao Cave barbarians rebelled; he was summoned to surrender and appointed Pacification Commissioner for Sanmao, Shiya, and other places; staff were established, patents and tiger tallies were granted, and relay stations were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Quanzai of the Sanmao Cave barbarians rebelled. He was summoned to surrender and appointed pacification commissioner for Sanmao, Shiya, and other places. Staff were established, patents and tiger tallies were granted, and relay stations were set up.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔選怯薛官為路、府、縣達魯花赤。

translations.literal: On guisi day, an edict ordered selection of keshik officials as darughachi for circuits, prefectures, and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, an edict ordered the selection of keshik officials as darughachi for circuits, prefectures, and counties.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以朵兒直班為中書右丞，答兒麻為參知政事。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Dorjiban was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat; Darmashiri was appointed vice grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Dorjiban was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat, and Darmashiri was appointed vice grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以御史大夫亦憐真班等知經筵事。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Censor-in-Chief Yilinjinban and others were ordered to direct the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Censor-in-Chief Yilinjinban and others were ordered to direct the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，京畿奉使宣撫定定奏言御史撒八兒等罪，杖黜之。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Dingding, pacification envoy of the capital region, reported the crimes of Censor Saba'er and others; they were beaten and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Dingding, pacification envoy of the capital region, reported the crimes of Censor Saba'er and others. They were beaten and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 時諸道奉使，皆與臺憲互相掩蔽，惟定定與湖廣道拔實糾舉無避。

translations.literal: At the time, envoys of the various circuits all shielded one another together with the censorate, but only Dingding and Bashi of the Huguang circuit impeached without evasion.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, envoys of the various circuits all shielded one another together with the censorate, but only Dingding and Bashi of the Huguang circuit impeached without evasion.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午朔，命江浙行省右丞忽都不花、江西行省右丞禿魯統軍合討羅天麟。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the first day bingwu of the month, Hu Dubai, right vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, and Tulu, right vice director of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, were ordered to command troops jointly to campaign against Luo Tianlin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the first day bingwu of the month, Hu Dubai, right vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, and Tulu, right vice director of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, were ordered to command troops jointly to campaign against Luo Tianlin.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wushen day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，克復長汀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yiyou day, Changting was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yiyou day, Changting was recovered.

sentences.zh: 戊子，邵武地震，有聲如鼓，至夜復鳴。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Shaowu suffered an earthquake; there was a sound like drums, and at night it sounded again.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Shaowu was struck by an earthquake. There was a sound like drums, and at night it sounded again.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，思、靖徭寇犯武岡，詔湖廣省臣及湖南宣慰元帥完者帖木兒討之，俘斬數百級，徭賊敗走。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, Yao bandits of Si and Jing raided Wugang; an edict ordered officials of the Huguang province and Wanzhe Temur, pacification marshal of Hunan, to campaign against them; several hundred were captured and beheaded, and the Yao bandits were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Yao bandits of Si and Jing raided Wugang. An edict ordered officials of Huguang province and Wanzhe Temur, pacification marshal of Hunan, to campaign against them. Several hundred were captured and beheaded, and the Yao bandits were defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥朔，詔赦天下，免差稅三分，水旱之地全免。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on yihai, the first day of the month, an edict proclaimed general amnesty throughout the empire, exempting three-tenths of corvée and tax levies; in flood and drought areas remission was total.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the first yihai day, an edict proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the empire, exempting three-tenths of corvée and tax levies, with full remission in flood- and drought-stricken areas.

sentences.zh: 靖州徭賊吳天保陷黔陽。

translations.literal: The Yao bandit Wu Tianbao of Jingzhou captured Qianyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tianbao, a Yao bandit from Jingzhou, captured Qianyang.

sentences.zh: 癸未，汀州賊徒羅德用殺首賊羅天麟、陳積萬，以首級送官，余黨悉平。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, the bandit follower Luo Deyong of Tingzhou killed the chief bandits Luo Tianlin and Chen Jiwang, sent their heads to the authorities, and all remaining accomplices were suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Luo Deyong, a bandit follower in Tingzhou, killed the chief bandits Luo Tianlin and Chen Jiwang, sent their heads to the authorities, and all remaining accomplices were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，省臣改擬明宗母壽童皇后徽號曰莊獻嗣聖皇后。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingchou day, provincial officials revised the honorific title of Empress Shoutong, mother of Mingzong, to Empress Zhuangxian Sisheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingchou day, provincial officials revised the honorific title of Empress Shoutong, mother of Mingzong, to Empress Zhuangxian Sisheng.

sentences.zh: 己卯，改立山東東西道宣慰使司都元帥府，開設屯田，駐軍馬。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the Pacification Commissioner's office and chief-marshal headquarters of the Eastern and Western Shandong Circuit was reorganized, garrison colonization fields were established, and troops were stationed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the pacification commissioner's office and chief-marshal headquarters of the Eastern and Western Shandong Circuit was reorganized, garrison colonization fields were established, and troops were stationed there.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔復立大護國仁王寺昭應宮財用規運總管府，凡貸民間錢二十六萬餘錠。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, an edict restored the Great State-Protecting Temple of the Benevolent King Zhaoying Palace Financial Planning and Transport Commission, with total loans to the populace amounting to more than two hundred sixty thousand ingots.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, an edict restored the financial planning and transport commission for the Great State-Protecting Temple of the Benevolent King's Zhaoying Palace, totaling over two hundred sixty thousand ingots in loans to the populace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，有司以賞賚泛濫，奏請恩賜必先經省、臺、院定擬。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, because rewards and stipends had become indiscriminate, officials petitioned that bestowal of imperial favors must first be determined by the Secretariat, Censorate, and Palace Service.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, because rewards and stipends had grown indiscriminate, officials petitioned that imperial favors must first be reviewed by the Secretariat, Censorate, and Palace Service.

sentences.zh: 甲午，設立海剌禿屯田二處。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, two garrison colonization fields were established at Hailatu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, two garrison colonization fields were established at Hailatu.

sentences.zh: 詔：「犯贓罪之人，常選不用。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Persons guilty of corruption shall not be employed in regular selection.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Persons guilty of corruption shall be barred from regular appointment.

sentences.zh: 」復立八百宣慰司，以土官韓部襲其父爵。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commission of Baibu was re-established, with the native official Han Bu succeeding to his father's title.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commission of Baibu was re-established, with the native official Han Bu succeeding to his father's title.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以吉剌班為太尉，開府，置僚屬。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Jirban was appointed Grand Commandant, opened a commandery office, and staff officials were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Jirban was appointed grand commandant, opened a commandery office, and staff officials were appointed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，山東、河南盜起，遣左、右阿速衛指揮不兒國等討之。

translations.literal: On renyin day, bandits rose in Shandong and Henan; Buriguo and others, commanders of the Left and Right Asud Guard, were dispatched to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, bandits rose in Shandong and Henan, and Buriguo and others, commanders of the Left and Right Asud Guard, were dispatched to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，黃河決。

translations.literal: That year, the Yellow River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Yellow River burst its banks.

sentences.zh: 尚書李絅請躬祀郊廟，近正人，遠邪佞，以崇陽抑陰，不聽。

translations.literal: Minister Li Shen requested that the emperor personally perform sacrifices at the suburban altars and ancestral temple, draw near upright persons, keep far from wicked flatterers, and exalt yang while repressing yin; the request was not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Li Shen requested that the emperor personally perform sacrifices at the suburban altars and ancestral temple, draw near upright persons, keep far from wicked flatterers, and exalt yang while repressing yin. The request was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, on jiachen, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the first jiachen day of the first month of spring, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 大寒而風，朝官仆者數人。

translations.literal: There was bitter cold with wind, and several court officials were blown down.
translations.idiomatic: Bitter cold and wind blew several court officials off their feet.

sentences.zh: 己酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命中書左丞相別兒怯不花為右丞相，尋辭職。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Bers Bekbunaq of the left chief ministership of the Secretariat was appointed right chief minister; he soon resigned his post.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Bers Bekbunaq was appointed from left to right chief minister of the Secretariat. He soon resigned his post.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，復立東路都蒙古軍都元帥府。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the Chief-Marshal Headquarters of the Eastern Route Mongol Army was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the chief-marshal headquarters of the Eastern Route Mongol Army was re-established.

sentences.zh: 庚申，雲南老丫等蠻來降，立老丫耿凍路軍民總管府。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the Lao Ya and other barbarians of Yunnan came to surrender; the General Military-Civilian Administration of the Lao Ya Gengdong Route was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the Lao Ya and other peoples of Yunnan came to surrender, and the general military-civilian administration of the Lao Ya Gengdong Route was established.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以廣西宣慰使章伯顏討徭、獠有功，升湖廣行省左丞。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Zhang Boyan, pacification commissioner of Guangxi, who had merit in campaigning against the Yao and Liao, was promoted to left vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Zhang Boyan, pacification commissioner of Guangxi, who had distinguished himself campaigning against the Yao and Liao, was promoted to left vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔以怯薛丹支給浩繁，除累朝定額外，悉罷之。

translations.literal: An edict stated that because keshik stipends had become excessively numerous, aside from the fixed quotas of successive reigns, all others were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that because keshik stipends had grown excessively numerous, all payments beyond the fixed quotas of successive reigns were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌朔，興聖宮作佛事，賜鈔二千錠。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiaxu, the first day of the month, Buddhist rites were performed at the Xingsheng Palace, and two thousand ingots of paper money were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the first jiaxu day, Buddhist rites were performed at the Xingsheng Palace, and two thousand ingots of paper money were bestowed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，山東地震，壞城郭，棣州有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Shandong was struck by an earthquake; city walls were destroyed, and in Di Prefecture the sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Shandong was struck by an earthquake that destroyed city walls. In Di Prefecture the sound was like thunder.

sentences.zh: 河南、山東盜蔓延濟寧、滕、邳、徐州等處。

translations.literal: Bandits in Henan and Shandong spread to Jining, Teng, Pi, Xuzhou, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits in Henan and Shandong spread into Jining, Teng, Pi, Xuzhou, and other places.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以中書參知政事鎖南班為中書右丞，道童為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Suonamban, vice director of the Secretariat, was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat, and Daotong was appointed vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Suonamban was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat, and Daotong was appointed vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以宦者伯帖木兒為司徒。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, the eunuch Botemur was appointed Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the eunuch Botemur was appointed minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 是月，徭賊吳天保寇沅州。

translations.literal: That month, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao raided Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao raided Yuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以阿吉剌為知樞密院事，整治軍務。

translations.literal: Azhila was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs to rectify military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Azhila was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs to rectify military affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，中書省臣言：「世祖之朝，省、臺、院奏事，給事中專掌之，以授國史纂修。

translations.literal: Third month, on jiachen day, officials of the Secretariat stated: "In the reign of Shizu, memorials from the Secretariat, Censorate, and Palace Service were kept in charge by the supervising secretary, to be delivered to the national history compilers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiachen day, officials of the Secretariat stated: "In the reign of Shizu, memorials from the Secretariat, Censorate, and Palace Service were handled by the supervising secretary and delivered to the national history compilers.

sentences.zh: 近年廢弛，恐萬世之後，一代成功無從稽考，乞復舊制。

translations.literal: In recent years this practice has fallen into disuse. I fear that ten thousand generations hence the achievements of an entire age will have no means of verification, and beg that the old system be restored."
translations.idiomatic: In recent years this practice has fallen into disuse. I fear that generations hence the achievements of an entire age will have no means of verification, and beg that the old system be restored."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣使銓選雲南官員。

translations.literal: On yisi day, envoys were dispatched to select and appoint officials in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, envoys were dispatched to select and appoint officials in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 修光天殿。
