translations.literal: The Hall of Radiant Heaven was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Radiant Heaven was repaired.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，試國子監，會食弟子員，選補路府及各衛學正。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the National University was examined, and student members who shared communal meals were selected and appointed as rectors of routes, prefectures, and the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the National University was examined, and student members who shared communal meals were selected and appointed as rectors of routes, prefectures, and the various guards.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔編《六條政類》。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, an edict ordered the compilation of the 《Six Categories of Governance》.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, an edict ordered the compilation of the 《Six Categories of Governance》.

sentences.zh: 庚申，監察御史王士點劾集賢大學士吳直方躐進官階，奪其宣命，乙丑，雲南王孛羅來獻死可伐之捷。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Supervising Censor Wang Shidian impeached Wu Zhifang, grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, for leapfrogging in official rank and had his commission revoked; on yichou day, Prince Boluo of Yunnan came to present news of victory over Sikewa.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Supervising Censor Wang Shidian impeached Wu Zhifang, grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, for leapfrogging in official rank and had his commission revoked. On the yichou day, Prince Boluo of Yunnan came to present news of victory over Sikewa.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遣使修上都大乾元寺。

translations.literal: On renshen day, envoys were dispatched to repair the Great Qianyuan Temple at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, envoys were dispatched to repair the Great Qianyuan Temple at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 命有司定吊賻諸王、公主、駙馬禮儀之數。

translations.literal: Officials were ordered to determine the prescribed rituals and amounts for mourning gifts to princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were ordered to determine the prescribed rituals and amounts for mourning gifts to princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，命江浙省臣講究役法。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yihai day, officials of the Jiang-Zhe province were ordered to investigate corvée regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yihai day, officials of the Jiang-Zhe province were ordered to investigate corvée regulations.

sentences.zh: 己卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，遣達本、賀方使於占城。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Daben and Hefang were dispatched as envoys to Champa.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Daben and Hefang were dispatched as envoys to Champa.

sentences.zh: 以通政院使朵郎吉兒為遼陽行省參知政事，討吾者野人。

translations.literal: Duolangjir, director of the Bureau of Transmission, was appointed vice director of the Liaoyang branch secretariat to campaign against the Wuzhe barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Duolangjir, director of the Bureau of Transmission, was appointed vice director of the Liaoyang branch secretariat to campaign against the Wuzhe barbarians.

sentences.zh: 己丑，發米二十萬石賑糶貧民。

translations.literal: On jichou day, two hundred thousand shi of grain was issued and sold for relief to impoverished people.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, two hundred thousand shi of grain was issued and sold at relief prices to impoverished people.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨定住為中書右丞。

translations.literal: Dingzhu, Academician Expositor of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhu, academician expositor of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，復命別兒怯不花為中書右丞相。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Bers Bekbunaq was again appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Bers Bekbunaq was again appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以中書平章政事鐵木兒塔識為左丞相。

translations.literal: Temür Tash, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed left chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Temür Tash, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed left chief minister.

sentences.zh: 臨清、廣平、灤河等處盜起，遣兵捕之。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Linqing, Guangping, Luan River, and other places; troops were dispatched to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Linqing, Guangping, Luan River, and other places, and troops were dispatched to capture them.

sentences.zh: 通州盜起，監察御史言：「通州密邇京城，而盜賊蜂起，宜增兵討之，以杜其源。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Tongzhou. A supervising censor stated: "Tongzhou lies close to the capital, yet bandits are swarming forth. Troops should be increased to campaign against them and cut off the source."
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Tongzhou. A supervising censor stated: "Tongzhou lies close to the capital, yet bandits are swarming forth. Additional troops should be sent to campaign against them and cut off the source."

sentences.zh: 」不聽。

translations.literal: The proposal was not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 是月，河東大旱，民多饑死，遣使賑之。

translations.literal: That month, the region east of the Yellow River suffered severe drought; many people died of starvation; envoys were dispatched to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the region east of the Yellow River suffered severe drought, and many people died of starvation. Envoys were dispatched to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，徭賊吳天保陷武岡路，詔遣湖廣行省右丞沙班統軍討之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on gengxu day, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao captured Wugang Route; an edict dispatched Sha Ban, right vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat, to lead troops and campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the gengxu day, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao captured Wugang Route. An edict dispatched Sha Ban, right vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat, to lead troops and campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，右丞相別兒怯不花，以調燮失宜、災異叠見罷，詔以太保就第。

translations.literal: On yichou day, the right chief minister Bers Bekbunaq was dismissed for improper coordination and the repeated appearance of omens; an edict appointed him Grand Preceptor and ordered him to his residence.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, right chief minister Bers Bekbunaq was dismissed for improper coordination and the repeated appearance of omens. An edict appointed him grand preceptor and ordered him to his residence.

sentences.zh: 是月，臨淄地震，七日乃止。

translations.literal: That month, Linzi was struck by an earthquake, which continued for seven days before stopping.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Linzi was struck by an earthquake that continued for seven days before stopping.

sentences.zh: 六月，詔免太師馬劄兒臺官，安置西寧州，其子脫脫請與父俱行。

translations.literal: Sixth month, an edict dismissed Mazhiltai, Grand Preceptor, from his post and ordered him settled in Xining Prefecture; his son Toqto requested to accompany his father.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, an edict dismissed Mazhiltai, grand preceptor, from his post and ordered him settled in Xining Prefecture. His son Toqto requested to accompany his father.

sentences.zh: 以御史大夫太平為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: Taiping, censor-in-chief, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping, censor-in-chief, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 彰德路大饑，民相食。

translations.literal: Zhangde Route suffered great famine; the people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangde Route suffered great famine, and the people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，召隱士完者圖、執禮哈瑯為翰林待制，張樞、董立為翰林修撰，李孝先為著作郎。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiayin day, the recluses Wanzhe Tu and Zhili Halang were summoned and appointed Hanlin Attendants-in-Waiting; Zhang Shu and Dong Li were appointed Hanlin compilers; Li Xiaoxian was appointed Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiayin day, the recluses Wanzhe Tu and Zhili Halang were summoned and appointed Hanlin attendants-in-waiting; Zhang Shu and Dong Li were appointed Hanlin compilers; and Li Xiaoxian was appointed secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 張樞不至。

translations.literal: Zhang Shu did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shu did not come.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以江南行臺大夫納麟為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Nalin, chief commissioner of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat, was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Nalin, chief commissioner of the Jiangnan branch secretariat, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔：「左右丞相、平章、樞密知院、御史大夫，得賜玉押字印，余官不與。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, an edict stated: "The left and right chief ministers, chief ministers, directors of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and censor-in-chief may be granted jade character-press seals; other officials are not to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, an edict stated: "The left and right chief ministers, chief ministers, directors of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and censor-in-chief may be granted jade character-press seals. Other officials are not to receive them.

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，詔建木華黎、伯顏祠堂於東平。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, an edict ordered the construction of ancestral halls for Muqali and Bayan at Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, an edict ordered the construction of ancestral halls for Muqali and Bayan at Dongping.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，亦憐只答兒反，遣兵討之。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Yilinzhidaer rebelled; troops were dispatched to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Yilinzhidaer rebelled, and troops were dispatched to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，開東華射圃。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the Eastern Hua Archery Ground was opened.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the Eastern Hua Archery Ground was opened.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，西番盜起，凡二百餘所，陷哈剌火州，劫供禦蒲萄酒，殺使臣。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, bandits rose in Xifan, more than two hundred places in all; Harahuo Prefecture was captured, imperial tribute wine was plundered, and envoys were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, bandits rose in Xifan at more than two hundred places, capturing Harahuo Prefecture, plundering imperial tribute wine, and killing envoys.

sentences.zh: 是月，徭賊吳天保復寇沅州，州兵擊走之。

translations.literal: That month, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao again raided Yuan Prefecture; prefecture troops drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao again raided Yuan Prefecture, and prefecture troops drove him off.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，監察御史曲曲，以宦者隴普憑藉寵幸，驟升榮祿大夫，追封三代，田宅逾制，上疏劾之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinchou day, Supervising Censor Ququ submitted a memorial impeaching the eunuch Longpu for relying on imperial favor to be suddenly promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, ennobling three generations posthumously, and exceeding regulations in fields and residences.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinchou day, Supervising Censor Ququ submitted a memorial impeaching the eunuch Longpu for relying on imperial favor to be suddenly promoted to grand master of splendid happiness, ennobling three generations posthumously, and exceeding regulations in fields and residences.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，沿江盜起，剽掠無忌，有司莫能禁。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, bandits rose along the river, pillaging without restraint, and local officials could not suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, bandits rose along the river and pillaged without restraint, and local officials could not suppress them.

sentences.zh: 兩淮運使宋文瓚上言：「江陰、通泰，江海之門戶，而鎮江、真州次之，國初設萬戶府以鎮其地。

translations.literal: Song Wenhan, transport commissioner of the Two Huai, submitted: "Jiangyin and Tongtai are the gateways of the rivers and sea, with Zhenjiang and Zhenzhou ranking next. At the founding of the dynasty, wanhu garrisons were established to guard these places.
translations.idiomatic: Song Wenhan, transport commissioner of the Two Huai, submitted: "Jiangyin and Tongtai are the gateways of the rivers and sea, with Zhenjiang and Zhenzhou ranking next. At the founding of the dynasty, wanhu garrisons were established to guard these places.

sentences.zh: 今戍將非人，致使賊艦往來無常。

translations.literal: Now the garrison commanders are unworthy, causing bandit vessels to come and go without restraint."
translations.idiomatic: Now the garrison commanders are unworthy, causing bandit vessels to come and go without restraint."

sentences.zh: 集慶花山劫賊才三十六人，官軍萬數，不能進討，反為所敗，後竟假手鹽徒，雖能成功，豈不貽笑！

translations.idiomatic: The proposal was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 撥山東地土十六萬二千餘頃屬大承天護聖寺。

translations.literal: More than one hundred sixty-two thousand qing of land in Shandong was allocated to the Grand Chengtian State-Protecting Sacred Temple.
translations.idiomatic: More than one hundred sixty-two thousand qing of land in Shandong was allocated to the Grand Chengtian State-Protecting Sacred Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，中書戶部言：「各處水旱，田禾不收，湖廣、雲南盜賊蜂起，兵費不給，而各位怯薛冗食甚多，乞賜分柬。

sentences.zh: 」帝牽於眾請，令三年後減之。

translations.literal: The emperor, swayed by numerous petitions, ordered reduction after three years.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, swayed by numerous petitions, ordered that reductions take effect after three years.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯天廩。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Celestial Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Celestial Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 懷慶路饑。

translations.literal: Huaqing Route suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: Huaqing Route was starving.

sentences.zh: 徭賊吳天保復陷武岡，命湖廣行省平章政事茍爾領兵討之。

translations.literal: The Yao bandit Wu Tianbao again captured Wugang; Gou Er, chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, was ordered to lead troops and campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao bandit Wu Tianbao again captured Wugang, and Gou Er, chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, was ordered to lead troops and campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 以河決，命工部尚書迷兒馬哈謨行視金堤。

translations.literal: Because the Yellow River burst its banks, Mir Mahmud, minister of the Ministry of Works, was ordered to go and inspect the Golden Dike.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Yellow River had burst its banks, Mir Mahmud, minister of the Ministry of Works, was ordered to inspect the Golden Dike.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，徭賊吳天保陷靖州，命威順王寬徹不花、鎮南王孛羅不花及湖廣、江西二省以兵討之。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao captured Jingzhou; the Prince of Weishun Wanchebuhua, the Prince of Zhennan Boluobuhua, and the two provinces of Huguang and Jiangxi were ordered to campaign against him with troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao captured Jingzhou. The Prince of Weishun Wanchebuhua, the Prince of Zhennan Boluobuhua, and the two provinces of Huguang and Jiangxi were ordered to campaign against him with troops.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命中書平章政事太平為左丞相，辭，不允。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Taiping, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed left chief minister; he resigned, but the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Taiping, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed left chief minister. He resigned, but the request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命河南、山東都府發兵討湖廣洞蠻。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the chief military commissions of Henan and Shandong were ordered to dispatch troops to campaign against the cave barbarians of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the chief military commissions of Henan and Shandong were ordered to dispatch troops to campaign against the cave barbarians of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 己未，以中書省平章政事韓嘉訥為陜西行臺御史大夫。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Han Jiana, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Han Jiana, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 迤北荒旱缺食，遣使賑濟驛戶。

translations.literal: In the far north there was drought and scarcity of food; envoys were dispatched to provide relief to postal households.
translations.idiomatic: In the far north, drought caused food shortages, and envoys were dispatched to provide relief to postal households.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，海北、湖南徭賊竊發，兩月餘，有司不以聞，詔罪之，並降散官一等。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Yao bandits secretly rose in Haibei and Hunan; for more than two months local officials did not report it; an edict punished them and reduced their honorary rank by one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Yao bandits secretly rose in Haibei and Hunan. For more than two months local officials did not report it, and an edict punished them and reduced their honorary rank by one grade.

sentences.zh: 是月，馬劄兒臺薨，召脫脫還京師。

translations.literal: That month, Mazhiltai died; Toqto was summoned back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Mazhiltai died, and Toqto was summoned back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月戊戌朔，命也先帖木兒知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, on wuxu, the first day of the month, Yesan Temur was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on the first wuxu day of the first month of spring, Yesan Temur was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，黃河決，遷濟寧路於濟州。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, the Yellow River burst its banks; Jining Route was relocated to Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the Yellow River burst its banks, and Jining Route was relocated to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 詔：「各官府諳練事務之人，毋得遷調。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Persons in each government office who are skilled in their duties shall not be transferred or reassigned.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Persons in each government office who are skilled in their duties shall not be transferred or reassigned.

sentences.zh: 」詔翰林國史院纂修后妃、功臣列傳，學士承旨張起巖、學士楊宗瑞、侍講學士黃溍為總裁官，左丞相太平、左丞呂思誠領其事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Hanlin Academy and National History Bureau to compile biographies of empresses and meritorious ministers; Academician Expositors Zhang Qiyan and Yang Zongrui and Hanlin Expositor Huang Jin were appointed chief compilers; Left Chief Minister Taiping and Left Vice Director Lü Sicheng were placed in charge of the project.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Hanlin Academy and National History Bureau to compile biographies of empresses and meritorious ministers. Academician Expositors Zhang Qiyan and Yang Zongrui and Hanlin Expositor Huang Jin were appointed chief compilers, and Left Chief Minister Taiping and Left Vice Director Lü Sicheng were placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 甲子，木憐等處大雪，羊馬凍死，賑之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, heavy snow fell at Mulin and other places; sheep and horses froze to death; relief was provided.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, heavy snow fell at Mulin and other places, sheep and horses froze to death, and relief was provided.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔給銅虎符，以宮尉完者不花、貴赤衛副指揮使壽山監湖廣軍。

translations.literal: That month, an edict granted bronze tiger tallies appointing Palace Guard Wanzhebuhua and Vice Commander Shoushan of the Imperial Guard to supervise the Huguang army.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict granted bronze tiger tallies appointing Palace Guard Wanzhebuhua and Vice Commander Shoushan of the Imperial Guard to supervise the Huguang army.

sentences.zh: 命湖廣行省右丞禿赤、湖南宣慰都元帥完者帖木兒討莫磐洞諸蠻，斬首數百級，其餘二十餘洞，縛其洞首楊鹿五赴京師。

translations.literal: Tuochi, right vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat, and Wanzhe Temur, pacification marshal of Hunan, were ordered to campaign against the barbarians of the Mo Pan caves; several hundred heads were taken, and the chieftain Yang Luwu of the remaining twenty-odd caves was bound and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Tuochi, right vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat, and Wanzhe Temur, pacification marshal of Hunan, were ordered to campaign against the barbarians of the Mo Pan caves. sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，御史大夫納麟加太尉致仕。

translations.literal: Second month, on guiyou day, Nalin, censor-in-chief, was promoted to Grand Commandant and retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guiyou day, Nalin, censor-in-chief, was promoted to grand commandant and retired from office.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以北邊沙土苦寒，罷海剌禿屯田。

translations.literal: On yihai day, because the northern border's sandy soil was bitterly cold, Hailatu garrison colonization fields were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, because the sandy soil on the northern frontier was bitterly cold, the garrison colonization fields at Hailatu were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命太子愛猷識理達臘習讀畏吾兒文字。

translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the crown prince Ayurshiridara was ordered to study Uyghur script.

translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the moon transgressed the Level Road.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命星吉為江南行臺御史大夫。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Singgi was appointed censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Singgi was appointed censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Taiping submitted: "The garrison colonization fields at Beda, Naitu, and Mangwu were allocated from old mobile-camp stations to the Tiger Guard Bureau during the Shizu reign, but were later seized by powerful magnates and lost their benefits. translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

translations.idiomatic: That month, because Jia Weizhen, the former circuit pacification commissioner, had performed his duties well, he was specially appointed route commander of Yongping.

translations.idiomatic: Famine struck that year, and Weizhen requested the issuance of more than forty thousand ingots of paper money for relief.

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the establishment of a branch directorate of waterways at Jining in Yuncheng, with Jia Lu appointed superintendent of waterways.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingyou day, an edict ordered that bundles of silk be bestowed to commend county and prefecture magistrates who were incorrupt and diligent.

sentences.zh: 遼東鎖火奴反，詐稱大金子孫，水達達路脫脫禾孫唐兀火魯火孫討擒之。

sentences.zh: 壬寅，土番盜起，有司請不拘資級，委官討之。

translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, bandits rose among the Tufan, and local officials requested that officials be appointed without regard to rank or grade to campaign against them.

translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Fujian. Because the region was distant and difficult to pursue and capture, an edict ordered the establishment of subordinate chief-marshal headquarters in Ting and Zhang prefectures to govern the area.

translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the emperor personally examined seventy-eight jinshi candidates. Aruhui Temur and Wang Zongzhe were granted jinshi with highest honors, and the rest received degrees of varying rank.

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the Huguang branch secretariat dispatched envoys to present a report of victory over the Shibi Cave barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the Huguang branch secretariat dispatched envoys to present a report of victory over the Shibi Cave barbarians.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，太陰犯建星。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣使詣江浙、江西、湖廣、四川、雲南銓福建、番、廣蠻夷等處官員選。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, envoys were dispatched to Jiangzhe, Jiangxi, Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan to conduct official selection for Fujian, Fan, Guang, and other barbarian regions.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, envoys were dispatched to Jiangzhe, Jiangxi, Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan to conduct official selection for Fujian, Fan, Guang, and other barbarian regions.

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Wuyan Boluhuan of Liaoyang falsely claimed to be a descendant of the Jin, received jade-emperor talismanic writs, and raised rebellion; government troops campaigned against him and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Wuyan Boluhuan of Liaoyang falsely claimed to be a descendant of the Jin, received jade-emperor talismanic writs, and raised rebellion. Government troops campaigned against him and executed him.

translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the 《Six Categories of Governance》 was completed.

translations.idiomatic: The people of the capital region were starving.

translations.idiomatic: Qarbuqa, darughachi of Huizhou Route, became known for his administrative achievements, and an edict bestowed gold and silk to commend him.

translations.literal: That month, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao again raided Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao again raided Yuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，河間等路以連年河決，水旱相仍，戶口消耗，乞減鹽額，詔從之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinwei day, Hejian and other routes, because the Yellow River had burst its banks year after year and flood and drought had followed one upon another, causing population decline, petitioned to reduce the salt quota; an edict granted the request.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinwei day, Hejian and other routes petitioned to reduce the salt quota because the Yellow River had burst its banks year after year and flood and drought had followed one upon another, causing population decline. An edict granted the request.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，帝幸國子學，賜衍聖公銀印，升秩從二品。

translations.literal: On yihai day, the emperor visited the National University; the Duke for the Extension of Sageliness was granted a silver seal and promoted to the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the emperor visited the National University. The Duke for the Extension of Sageliness was granted a silver seal and promoted to the second rank.

sentences.zh: 定弟子員出身及奔喪、省親等法。

translations.literal: Regulations were established for the appointment of student members and for mourning leave, home visits, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations were established for the appointment of student members and for mourning leave, home visits, and related matters.

translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Magistrates shall select and appoint village chiefs to devote themselves exclusively to encouraging agriculture and sericulture."

sentences.zh: 」詔：「京官三品以上，歲舉守令一人，守令到任三月，亦舉一人自代。

translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Capital officials of the third rank and above shall each year recommend one magistrate. Magistrates, three months after taking office, shall likewise recommend one person to succeed themselves."

sentences.zh: 其玉典赤、拱衛百戶，不得授縣達魯花赤，止授佐貳，久著廉能則用之。

translations.literal: Yuandianchi and archer-guard centurions may not be appointed county darughachi, but only deputy posts; if they long show incorruptibility and competence, they may then be employed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuandianchi and archer-guard centurions may not be appointed county darughachi, but only deputy posts. If they long show incorruptibility and competence, they may then be employed.

translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang and Songjiang suffered flood damage, and one hundred thousand shi of sea-transport grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遼陽董哈剌作亂，鎮撫欽察討擒之。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Dong Qara of Liaoyang raised rebellion; the pacification commissioner Qincha captured him.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Dong Qara of Liaoyang raised rebellion. The pacification commissioner Qincha captured him.

sentences.zh: 己卯，海寧州沐陽縣等處盜起，遣翰林學士禿堅不花討之。

translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, bandits rose at Muyang County in Haining Prefecture and elsewhere. Hanlin Academician Tujianbuhua was dispatched to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 是月，享於太廟。

translations.literal: That month, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: That month, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 命脫脫為太傅。

translations.literal: Toqto was appointed Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Toqto was appointed grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 湖廣章伯顏引兵捕土寇莫萬五、蠻雷等，已而廣西峒賊乘隙入寇，伯顏退走。

translations.literal: Zhang Boyan of Huguang led troops to capture the local bandits Mo Wanwu, Man Lei, and others; soon after, cave bandits of Guangxi seized the opportunity to invade, and Boyan withdrew in retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Boyan of Huguang led troops to capture the local bandits Mo Wanwu, Man Lei, and others. Soon after, cave bandits of Guangxi seized the opportunity to invade, and Boyan withdrew in retreat.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉朔，大霖雨，京城崩。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dingyou, the first day of the month, heavy rains fell and the capital's walls collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the first dingyou day of the month, heavy rains fell and the capital's walls collapsed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，廣西山崩，水湧，漓江溢，平地水深二丈餘，屋宇、人畜漂沒。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, mountains collapsed in Guangxi, water surged forth, the Li River overflowed, and water in level areas reached more than two zhang in depth; buildings, people, and livestock were swept away and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, mountains collapsed in Guangxi, water surged forth, and the Li River overflowed. Water in level areas reached more than two zhang in depth, and buildings, people, and livestock were swept away and drowned.

sentences.zh: 壬子，寶慶大水。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Baoqing suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Baoqing suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，四川旱，饑，禁酒。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Sichuan suffered drought and famine; the sale of wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Sichuan suffered drought and famine, and the sale of wine was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅朔，升徐州為總管府，以邳、宿、滕、嶧四州隸之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingyin, the first day of the month, Xuzhou was promoted to a route headquarters, with the four prefectures of Pi, Su, Teng, and Yi placed under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the first bingyin day of the month, Xuzhou was promoted to a route headquarters, with the four prefectures of Pi, Su, Teng, and Yi placed under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，立司天臺於上都。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, an Astronomical Bureau was established at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, an astronomical bureau was established at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 是月，山東大水，民饑，賑之。

translations.literal: That month, Shandong suffered great flooding; the people were starving, and relief was provided.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shandong suffered great flooding. The people were starving, and relief was provided.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingshen, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first bingshen day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復立五道河屯田。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the Wudao River garrison colonization fields were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the Wudao River garrison colonization fields were re-established.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On yisi day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 旌表大都節婦鞏氏門。

translations.literal: The gate of the chaste widow Lady Gong of Dadu was honored with an inscribed commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The gate of the chaste widow Lady Gong of Dadu was honored with an inscribed commendation.

sentences.zh: 戊申，西北邊軍民饑，遣使賑之。

translations.literal: On wushen day, soldiers and civilians on the northwestern frontier were starving; envoys were dispatched to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, soldiers and civilians on the northwestern frontier were starving, and envoys were dispatched to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，量移竄徙官於近地安置，死者聽歸葬。

translations.literal: On renzi day, officials who had been transferred by degree or exiled were ordered settled in nearby places; those who died were permitted to be returned home for burial.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, officials who had been transferred by degree or exiled were ordered settled in nearby places. Those who died were permitted to be returned home for burial.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣使祭曲阜孔子廟。

translations.literal: On yimao day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Confucius Temple in Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Confucius Temple in Qufu.

sentences.zh: 江州路總管劉恒有政績，升授山東宣慰使。

translations.literal: Liu Heng, route commander of Jiangzhou, had administrative achievements and was promoted and appointed pacification commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Heng, route commander of Jiangzhou, had distinguished administrative achievements and was promoted and appointed pacification commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以阿剌不花為大司徒。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Aragbuhua was appointed Grand Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Aragbuhua was appointed grand minister of education.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingzi day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingzi day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 己卯，山東雨雹。

translations.literal: On jimao day, hail fell in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, hail fell in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，太陰犯靈臺。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Celestial Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Celestial Terrace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，廣西蠻掠道州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dinghai day, Guangxi barbarians raided Dao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dinghai day, Guangxi barbarians raided Dao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，徭賊吳天保率眾六萬掠全州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinhai day, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao led a force of sixty thousand to raid Quan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinhai day, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao led a force of sixty thousand to raid Quan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔賜高年帛，設分元帥府於沂州，以買列的為元帥，備山東寇。

translations.literal: That year, an edict bestowed silk upon the elderly; a subordinate chief-marshal headquarters was established at Yizhou, with Bairidi as marshal, to guard against bandits in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That year, an edict bestowed silk upon the elderly. A subordinate chief-marshal headquarters was established at Yizhou, with Bairidi appointed marshal to guard against bandits in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 臺州方國珍為亂，聚眾海上，命江浙行省參知政事朵兒只班討之。

translations.literal: Fang Guozhen of Taizhou raised rebellion, gathering a force on the sea; Dorbajiban, vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was ordered to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guozhen of Taizhou raised rebellion and gathered a force on the sea. Dorbajiban, vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was ordered to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 監察御史張楨劾太尉阿乞剌欺罔之罪，又言：「明裏董阿、也裏牙、月魯不花，皆陛下不共戴天之仇，伯顏賊殺宗室嘉王、郯王一十二口，稽之古法，當伏門誅，而其子、兄弟尚仕於朝，宜急誅竄。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Zhang Zhen impeached Grand Commandant Aqila for the crime of deception, and further submitted: "Mingli Dong'a, Yeliya, and Yuerbuhua are all Your Majesty's mortal enemies. Bayan treacherously killed twelve members of the imperial clan, the Prince of Jia and the Prince of Tan; measured against ancient law, he should have suffered execution at the gate, yet his sons and brothers still hold office at court and should urgently be executed and exiled."
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor Zhang Zhen impeached Grand Commandant Aqila for the crime of deception and further submitted: "Mingli Dong'a, Yeliya, and Yuerbuhua are all Your Majesty's mortal enemies. Bayan treacherously killed twelve members of the imperial clan, the Prince of Jia and the Prince of Tan. Measured against ancient law, he should have suffered execution at the gate, yet his sons and brothers still hold office at court and should urgently be executed and exiled."

sentences.zh: 別兒怯不花阿附權奸，亦宜遠貶。

translations.literal: Bierqiebuhua, who fawned upon powerful villains, should likewise be banished to a distant post.
translations.idiomatic: Bierqiebuhua, who fawned upon powerful villains, should likewise be banished to a distant post.

sentences.zh: 今災異叠見，盜賊蜂起，海寇敢於要君，閫帥敢於玩寇，若不振舉，恐有唐末藩鎮噬臍之禍。

translations.literal: Now omens appear one after another, bandits swarm forth, sea raiders dare to hold the ruler hostage, and frontier commanders dare to treat bandits lightly; if no vigorous action is taken, I fear the disaster of late Tang regional commanders biting at their own navels.
translations.idiomatic: Now omens appear one after another, bandits swarm forth, sea raiders dare to hold the ruler hostage, and frontier commanders dare to treat bandits lightly. If no vigorous action is taken, I fear the disaster of late Tang regional commanders biting at their own navels.

sentences.zh: 」不聽。

translations.literal: The memorial was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was not heeded.

sentences.zh: 監察御史李泌言：「世祖誓不與高麗共事，陛下踐世祖之位，何忍忘世祖之言，乃以高麗奇氏亦位皇后。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Li Bi submitted: "Shizu swore never to serve together with Goryeo. Your Majesty has ascended Shizu's throne—how can you bear to forget Shizu's words, yet make Empress Gi of Goryeo hold the empress's seat as well?"
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor Li Bi submitted: "Shizu swore never to serve together with Goryeo. Your Majesty has ascended Shizu's throne—how can you bear to forget Shizu's words, yet make Empress Gi of Goryeo hold the empress's seat as well?"

sentences.zh: 今災異屢起，河決地震，盜賊滋蔓，皆陰盛陽微之象，乞仍降為妃，庶幾三辰奠位，災異可息。

translations.literal: Now omens arise repeatedly, the Yellow River bursts its banks, earthquakes occur, and bandits spread unchecked—all signs of yin flourishing and yang declining. I beg that she be demoted again to consort, so that the three luminaries may settle in their places and the omens may cease.
translations.idiomatic: Now omens arise repeatedly, the Yellow River bursts its banks, earthquakes occur, and bandits spread unchecked—all signs of yin flourishing and yang declining. I beg that she be demoted again to consort, so that the three luminaries may settle in their places and the omens may cease.

sentences.zh: 」不聽。

translations.literal: The memorial was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was not heeded.
